title: Open-directions cards -- the no-approved-therapy tail rendered as actionable, falsifiable corrective-direction hypotheses
native_to: vp_disease_emergence_kit (ROADMAP III-A); read-only over the frozen III-A2 scanner output + each disease's frozen corrective-direction falsifier
principle: a disease with no approved therapy is only ACTIONABLE if the forced corrective direction comes with (a) a concrete candidate drug CLASS to test -- supplied by the repurposing scanner when a same-axis approved donor exists, honestly NULL otherwise -- and (b) the single CHEAPEST experiment that would refute the direction.  Both are read from frozen artifacts; nothing is invented.
firewall: DIRECTION + CANDIDATE CLASS + FALSIFIER ONLY; never dose, potency, efficacy, response rate, or a specific-product efficacy claim; every card is [O] for magnitude + [F] for the cited direction; a card with no falsification experiment fails the gate; read-only, perturbs no per-disease hash.  Machine artifact -- the HTML site carries the patient-facing disclaimer.
grade: [F] corrective direction forced + cited ; [O] all magnitude / efficacy / candidate-class success

cards.emergent_axis: photoreceptor / RPE / choroid Rab-prenylation-dependent intracellular vesicular-trafficking maintenance (REP1-supported Rab geranylgeranylation) -- a THIRD ocular axis, the Rab-prenylation/vesicular-trafficking contrast to LCA2's retinoid-cycle enzyme axis and XLRP's ciliary-trafficking axis
cards.cheapest_falsification_experiment: ERG, OCT outer-nuclear-layer / autofluorescence area and microperimetry response to AAV2-REP1 in REP1-deficient retina (mouse, patient)
cards.novelty: low-novelty (confirmatory: the recipient already pursues this mechanism class -- the scanner here merely VALIDATES its same-axis logic, a sanity check)
cards.grade: [F] corrective direction forced + cited ; [O] candidate-class efficacy / dose / repurposing-success NOT asserted
cards.honesty_caveat: same-axis != same-disease -- this is a mechanism-CLASS DIRECTION hypothesis, not a prediction; the donor and recipient differ in tissue / delivery / allele / off-target biology, any of which may defeat repurposing.  No magnitude is claimed [O].

cards.disease: Dravet syndrome (SCN1A; NaV1.1 loss-of-function, GABAergic-interneuron haploinsufficiency)
cards.emergent_axis: GABAergic-interneuron NaV1.1 sodium current / cortical inhibitory tone -- SCN1A haploinsufficiency lowers NaV1.1 in fast-spiking inhibitory interneurons so they cannot fire repetitively, collapsing GABAergic inhibition (axis DOWN) and disinhibiting cortical networks (downstream excitation up). The kit's first NEURONAL ion-channel (epilepsy) axis, the inhibitory-interneuron contrast to LQT3's cardiac NaV1.5 gain
cards.cheapest_falsification_experiment: seizure frequency on SCN1A upregulation vs on a sodium-channel blocker in Scn1a+/- mice / Dravet patients (the phenytoin / carbamazepine worsening is the predicted control)
cards.novelty: orphan-direction (no same-axis approved donor exists to repurpose from -- the [F] direction is the actionable claim; the cheapest experiment below would refute it)

cards.disease: Nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, X-linked (AVPR2 loss-of-function; vasopressin V2 receptor)
cards.emergent_axis: renal collecting-duct urine-concentrating drive -- the vasopressin V2 receptor (V2R) -> Gs -> cAMP -> PKA -> AQP2 apical water-channel insertion axis. AVPR2 LOF (mostly receptor misfolding / ER retention) removes the vasopressin-response drive so water reabsorption fails despite hormone (axis DOWN). The kit's first GPCR axis and first second-messenger (cAMP) receptor-signalling axis, the metabotropic-GPCR contrast to the ion-channel reads (CFTR, K_ATP, NaV)
cards.cheapest_falsification_experiment: urine osmolality / AQP2 membrane insertion response to a V2R pharmacochaperone in a misfolding-AVPR2 model or patient

cards.disease: Autosomal dominant retinitis pigmentosa, RHO-related (adRP; RHO toxic gain-of-function / rhodopsin misfolding, e.g. P23H)
cards.emergent_axis: rod photoreceptor outer-segment maintenance / proteostatic throughput -- a toxic misfolded rhodopsin species (the P23H class-II majority) acts as an over-active pathological brake on photoreceptor homeostasis, the maintenance axis pushed DOWN (the proteinopathy pattern: HTT, TTR, SOD1 -> remove the toxic species). The kit's first ocular proteinopathy and first toxic-GAIN ocular read, the gain contrast to the three loss-of-function ocular reads (RPE65 enzyme, RPGR cilia, CHM Rab-prenylation)
cards.cheapest_falsification_experiment: photoreceptor survival / ERG response to allele-specific RHO knockdown in a P23H adRP retina

cards.disease: Usher syndrome type 2A (USH2A loss-of-function; usherin, the photoreceptor periciliary-membrane / hair-cell ankle-link complex protein) -- combined congenital sensorineural hearing loss + retinitis pigmentosa
cards.emergent_axis: photoreceptor outer-segment / periciliary-membrane-complex maintenance throughput (and, in the cochlea, the hair-cell stereocilia ankle-link integrity). USH2A LOF removes usherin, the structural-adhesion scaffold of the connecting-cilium periciliary region, so photoreceptor maintenance fails (progressive RP) and cochlear stereocilia development is disrupted (congenital sensorineural hearing loss) -- axis DOWN. The kit's FIFTH ocular read, its FIRST syndromic audio-visual read, and a structural-adhesion ocular gene class (the contrast to the retinoid-cycle enzyme / ciliary-trafficking / Rab-prenylation / rhodopsin-proteinopathy ocular reads)
cards.cheapest_falsification_experiment: ellipsoid-zone-width / visual-field / ERG trajectory under ultevursen vs sham in exon-13-mutant photoreceptors (e.g. patient iPSC-derived or animal model; the LUNA-style endpoint)
